name: Buffered Memory Model
description: A pragmatic, TSO-style buffered memory model proposed as a candidate for Java, motivated by building a verified JVM in the spirit of CompCertTSO rather than fully replacing the JMM. Each thread has a store buffer, so the principal relaxation over SC is store→load reordering. The authors proved the external DRF theorem and the soundness of several program transformations, and modified an open-source JVM to preserve BMM at roughly 1% average overhead on x86.

catSupport.note: A TSO-style buffered abstract machine for Java; machines of this shape have equivalent per-execution axiomatic forms (as x86-TSO does with x86tso.cat), but none is published for BMM.
